description: This file contains PHP code for handling the display logic and redirect behavior for the 'CallRelatedList' feature within the Leads module of vtiger CRM. It manages retrieving lead information, permissions, related lists, and rendering the related lists template.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: A Smarty templating engine class customized for vtiger CRM to facilitate rendering templates.

methods.name: retrieve_entity_info
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific lead entity based on its record ID.

methods.name: getEmailParentsList
methods.description: Fetches the list of parent emails associated with a lead.

methods.name: getModuleSequenceField
methods.description: Retrieves the sequence number field for a module, if any.

methods.name: getRelatedLists
methods.description: Gets related list data for the current module and lead.

methods.name: addRelatedModuleToSession
methods.description: Adds a related module header to the session for display purposes.

methods.name: getRelatedModulesFromSession
methods.description: Retrieves the list of related modules stored in the session.

methods.name: CheckFieldPermission
methods.description: Checks user permissions for specific fields within modules.

methods.name: updateInfo
methods.description: Generates update information for a particular entity record.

methods.name: Button_Check
methods.description: Determines whether specific UI buttons should be enabled or visible based on module and permissions.
